title: Come to Learn Holy Knowledge!
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh Stands)
O people, stand up for your Lord Allah Almighty. The whole of creation is standing up in his Divine Presence.
O people, give your most high respect and glorifying to your Lord, our creator. No one can be in existence if
he is not creating.
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
Allahu akbar Kabira wa 'l-hamdulillahi katheera wa subhanallahi 'l-`azheem wa bi hamdihi 'l-kareem
bukratan wa aseela.
O Allah,for the honour of Your most honoured one, in Your Divine Presence, forgive us. We are asking your
blessings, O our Lord. Give the most high honour that you are granting anyone through creation Sayiddina
Muhammad (s). Give him much more glory and praising.
Madad Ya Sayyidee and we are asking a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani
'r-Raheem. Try to learn what it means: a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Try to know what the
power of bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem is. That is a Heavenly, official language that was granted to the

Seal of Prophets Sayyidina Muhammad (s). He is the King, the Emperor and no one can reach his level and
his honour in the Divine Presence. An empire must have an emperor. There can't be an empire without an
emperor. O People, as-salaamu ` alaykum, that is an honour to you; to be addressed to all of you, as-salaamu
` alaykum. It is the most high honour that man is granted through holy stations, to be addressed by holy
name of Allah Almighty. He is as-Salaam, Jalla Jalaaluhu.
As-Salaam means that a person who is accepting and asking from his Creator, His holy name as-Salaam,
must be through safety here and hereafter. As-salaam, so honoured addressing from Heavens to Mankind.
Use that holy word. Leave to say "good morning", "good evening", "gunaydin". Other nations' people, Greeks
saying "kalimeras" through their language. They are saying some words, but all of them are imitated words.
No power in them. German people, what saying, "guten morgen"? Italian, what saying, "bon giorno"?
That is a saying that Shaytan is teaching people to use because it is such a plastic bone, for example. Nothing
in it, only emptiness. They are using this as a salaam, greeting. Yes, it is a greeting, but Heavenly greeting is
full with energy or power or lightening. If you are using, you may say an atom as a weapon, making a big
destroying because it has something in it. It is not empty. Also salaam has such a Heavenly power. When you
are saying as-salaamu ` alaykum, that is granting to you or it is a grant from Heavens to you. Heavens, they
are living ones. Everything is living there. Nothing is going to be sleeping or heedless or like dead one. No
death on Heavenly levels, no. Finished. Death is on this planet only; to take your imitated one from you and
to grant to you a real life's lightening and power. It gives that to you.
••••• •••• ••••••••• ••••• - Kullu man `alayha faan - everything on earth will perish, (55:26), holy words from
Holy Qu'ran. All of you are dead ones. In a blink of eye, you are coming and disappearing. That is the real
position for this planet. When you are leaving this and getting "up," you should find there, forever, in
Eternity. Eternity is through Heavens but temporary, is just the opposite of eternity. Whole creation on this
planet is nothing; temporary. Like this coming in existence and quickly going down or up. O people, try to
reach "up" worlds, "up" heavenly beings. Don't be stupid ones; don't be ignorant ones; don't be heedless ones.
You may lose only one chance you have been granted. Only once you should be in existence on this and you
may choose your way either Heavens or downs. "Up" levels, Heavenly levels; full with lightening and
lightening getting more and more and more. Not like a lamp, you may put in it paraffin, when finishing, this
finishing, no.

Heavenly beings are taking from Heavenly levels. They are going to be yamuddoon, providing from Divine
levels, never ending. That is the meaning of Eternity. Eternity is never getting less; getting more. O people,
therefore ask more and more and more. You should be granted. SubhaanAllah, Glory to our Creator. He is
sending that salaam as a living atom. Either taking you up or sending you down. That salaam, we are making
as an example, is like an atom, a living atom; living never getting to be un-living. Always living, because
yamuddoon, each atom providing from Heavens. Every atom that we are asking to say, as-salaam. Salaam is
such a living power. It is covered with Heavenly cover. When you are asking as-salaamu ` alaykum; when
giving that salaam, touching to you and giving to you a refreshment and renewment for your physical being.
Changing, because you have secret power. You are keeping that secret power, making you to move like this,
like that. Every function that you have been granted is a grant form Heavens.
That is an atom. What I am asking to say, atom of salaam. As-salaamu ` alaykum, gives to you such a power,
you can't imagine. That power, living power, never-ending power, taking you from the darkness of this planet
up to lightening Heavenly levels. O people, something that we have been granted. Only Prophets have such a
secret knowledge and coming to teach people their levels and their positions and their waziyat, missions.
Beware, don't lose that chance that you have been granted, to leave you. You are going to be a carcass.
Therefore, as-salaam qabl al-kalaam. The teacher of whole creation Sayyidina Muhammad (s) was saying, "O
People, first say salaam, then speak." That giving to you a power from salaam. Salaam giving to your real
being a power, through which you may reach ma`arib, ma`arib, what you are asking here or Hereafter. Here
nothing, but you must ask something that it should be for eternal (life). Always O people, ask Eternity,
Eternity. Don't lose your chance for reaching Eternity. You can't find over that position to be an eternal one.
Try to be eternal one. When you are going to be an eternal one, what kind of grant going to be granted to you,
you can't understand now. But try to reach that.
Yes, they are making a declaration for anyone. I'm a simple one also, but they are making me to speak. I don't
know but they are knowing and making to give such a mu`azhzham, magnificent positions, to people because
time is now coming closer, closer, closer. Our planet is going to finish and how many people on it, are
reaching their targets or to their limits. Some of them wasting their chance and reaching nothing. Some of
them gaining or winning such a power that forever you are running through oceans of Eternity. Never going

to get out. You are not asking (for) original. If running through Eternity oceans, no one asking to come out.
Never. Their real life through Eternity oceans and time is over now. Allah Almighty just sent 104 Heavenly
messages, commands, orders and holy books and finally Holy Qur'an. All these holy books bringing holy
knowledge. They are asking now, we are in need of holy knowledge. The knowledge that Shaytan teaching
people is finished. It is like sewage channels material. Never giving any benefit, for when they are changing
this life to another life.
Now we are in need of holy knowledge. O People! O Pope! O Bishops! O Chief Rabbis! O Patriarchs! O Dalai
Lama! Do you know this or not? If knowing, say to people, order them: O People, enough that you occupied
your most valuable beings for nothing, for imitated, dirty things. O People, you have been created to reach
holy knowledge. Now we are in need of holy knowledge. We must try to learn holy knowledge. If not, we are
going to be carcasses and thrown through sewage channels, like rats. Come and learn. Ask holy knowledge;
taking you up and up, seven levels of Heavens. O People, enough you are going to be drunk, drinking
whiskey, champagne, vodka, nabit. Don't drink cognac, don't drink whiskey, talky-walky, Johnny Walker.
Finished. You are going to be through sewage channels. Come and try to learn holy knowledge.
O People from the East to the West from North to South. Seventy two kinds of nations; you must close your
nonsense universities, academies and high schools. You must close them and open a new page for your life, to
teach your youngsters. To teach them and to train them for holy knowledge. Allah Allah, Allahu Akbar. O
People, that is important, that they are giving tonight. Tonight is very holy night for whole nations. Come and
accept holiness of this night and come and accept the month of this Friday night. Holy night and holy month.
Try to learn something. Leave everything and Allah Almighty grants to you everything - you can't think on it
or you can't imagine. O People, come and listen. I am an old one, I am nothing, but they are making me to
address to whole nations. Kings, queens and dictators, all of you! Come and learn holy knowledge. You
should be saved and honoured through this life and real life through Heavens. You may reach real life
through Eternity, through Eternal life.
May Allah forgive us. This is an endless ocean. Therefore, how many nights they are making my tongue to
speak, I don't know. They are giving an order to speak, to address whole nations. I don't think that anyone
may do any objection on this, when we are saying, 'O People try to learn Heavenly language and holy
knowledge. It gives you honour, pleasure, lightnings and enjoyment, here and Hereafter. Forever.' May Allah

forgive us. Fatihan.
Tawbah ya Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah

50... how much? 38... 48 must be... 38 masha Allah, I am looking and seeing more than this. How you are
saying 38?
It is okay, enough... enough...
